title: Family Group Post: ICU Pump Cyberattack Rumor

fields.avatarBrief: woman in her thirties, wearing a hospital gown with a name tag, holding a child
fields.text: My mom is in ICU 3 South at Ottawa River. A nurse just told me the pump gave her too much medicine this afternoon and hackers did it. Is anyone else hearing this? They are moving her to a different pump now.
fields.attachedImageBrief: blurry photo of a hospital room with a monitor showing a blank screen and a pump with a red alert icon

comments.author: Mark T.
comments.text: This is terrifying. I’ve been in ICU for three days and my daughter’s pump just changed to a new one. Is this real?

comments.author: Samantha L.
comments.text: The nurse said they’re not sure if it was a human error or a hack. I just want to know if my mom is safe.

comments.author: Dr. Elena (Family Member)
comments.text: I’m a nurse at ORRMC. The pump logs show a change in library settings, but we’re not confirming a hack yet. Please stay calm.

instructorNote: This inject introduces a family's emotional response to the incident, testing the PIO's ability to monitor misinformation without engaging. Watch for attempts to correct or defend the hospital in public.
